ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What will most likely happen to plant life if all of the herbivores are removed from this ecosystem?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web shows a node labeled Plant with arrows pointing from Plant toward herbivores such as Deer, Goat, and Grasshopper, indicating these animals eat plants. Other arrows show predators or higher consumers, such as Tiger, Snake, Eagle, and Mynah, connected to those plant-eating animals. Reasoning: The question asks what will happen to plant life if all herbivores are removed. Since the herbivores are the animals that consume the plants, removing them would greatly reduce grazing pressure on the plants. With fewer or no animals eating them, the plants would increase in number and grow more successfully.
